wf.title: Modern Medical Center Backlit Banner
wf.brief: I need a striking 14 ft × 8 ft back-lit banner for our medical center that instantly communicates a modern, premium feel. The doctors and their specialties must be the heroes of the design, supported by the center name, a concise list of core services, and any short contact line you feel balances the composition. You’ll receive professional headshots of our doctors; please blend these seamlessly with tasteful, high-quality medical stock imagery to reinforce each specialty. All photos will need colour correction and enhancement so they print crisply when the banner is illuminated. The overall aesthetic should be clean, contemporary and sophisticated—think confident typography, ample negative
wf.summary: Design a 14x8 ft backlit medical center banner: doctors and specialties as heroes, with name, services, contact line.

practice.q: Which element should be the visual focus of this banner?
options: The center's logo and name only
The doctors and their specialties
A long list of every service offered
practice.why: The client said the doctors and their specialties must be the heroes. Name, services and contact are supporting text. Keep the layout clean with plenty of negative space, and remember colour correction matters because the banner is lit from behind.
practice.need: I'll design the banner with your doctors as the hero, supported by clean type and print-ready photo enhancement.

wf.title: Logo Poster and Social Media Suite
wf.brief: I’m launching a new offer and need a cohesive visual toolkit to promote it. The job centres on three connected pieces—logo and brand identity, a print-ready poster/banner, and matching social media promotional graphics—so that every channel speaks the same visual language. Deliverables • Logo + mini brand guide: colour palette, typography, clear-space rules, supplied in AI, EPS, PDF, PNG, and JPG. • One high-resolution poster/banner design, sized for A2 print and easily resized for web banners. • Three social media promo graphics optimised for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, provided as layered PSD/AI and ready-to-post PNG files. Acceptance criteria 1. Two initial logo concepts and a mood
wf.summary: Client wants a matching logo, A2 poster and social graphics so all their channels share one visual style.

practice.q: What does the client really need from this job?
options: Just a logo, and the rest can wait
One consistent look across every channel
Only Instagram graphics in layered files
practice.why: The key word is cohesive: every logo, poster and post must share one palette, font set and spacing. That shared look is what the client is really buying.
practice.need: I'll build a logo, A2 poster and social set that all share one visual style.

wf.title: Polished Corporate Café Profile PDF
wf.brief: I’m putting together a sleek, email-ready PDF that introduces our café to corporate clients and partners. The document has to impress at first glance, so I’m looking for a designer-copywriter who can blend engaging visuals with concise, persuasive text. The profile must centre on two pillars: • our food and drink menu—quality, fresh ingredients, and the signature items that set us apart; • our corporate catering, event support, and partnership services, showing decision-makers exactly how we can enhance their meetings and functions. I’ll provide logos, colour guidelines, basic copy points, and photos. You refine the messaging, source any complementary imagery if required, and build a clean,
wf.summary: Design a polished, email-ready café PDF pitching your menu and corporate catering services to business clients.

practice.q: What does the client really need from this PDF?
options: A long list of every menu item and price
A concise, polished PDF pitching menu and corporate services
A full website redesign for the café
practice.why: Focus on the two pillars: menu quality and corporate catering. Keep copy short and persuasive, and let clean visuals do the first-glance work. Don't add extras the brief doesn't ask for.
practice.need: I'll design a sleek PDF that sells your menu and corporate catering at a glance.

wf.title: Premium Beauty Salon Print Design Suite
wf.brief: We are looking for a graphic designer to create a cohesive collection of printed promotional and informational materials for our beauty salon in Santa Monica, California. I’m attaching photos of our salon interior. All designs should complement the interior, match its colors and overall aesthetic, and look beautiful together. We want a modern, stylish, premium editorial look — not generic beauty salon templates. ### Materials Needed **1. Beauty Service Cards** - 5–6 promotional cards featuring nails, lashes, brows,, etc. - Beautiful photography, minimal text, consistent design. - For display in our waiting area and at reception. **2. Outdoor Advertising Board** - Redesign our existing rectan
wf.summary: Client wants a matching set of printed beauty cards and a redesigned outdoor board for their Santa Monica salon.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY want from this design suite?
options: Cheap, quick templates to fill print orders
One cohesive, premium look matching the salon
Digital ads and video content for social media
practice.why: Read the brief closely. They want a cohesive, premium editorial look that matches the salon interior, not generic templates. Consistency across every piece is the win.
practice.need: I'll design a cohesive, premium print set that matches your Santa Monica salon's interior.

wf.title: Mobile Accessories Digital Catalogue
wf.brief: I'm seeking a designer to create a professional digital catalogue for my mobile accessories. This catalogue will be used primarily for retailers and distributors. The catalogue should include: - Product photos - Product name - Model compatibility The final deliverable should be an editable design file, allowing for future updates as needed. Ideal skills and experience: - Proficiency in graphic design software (e.g., Adobe InDesign, Canva) - Experience in creating professional product catalogues - Strong attention to detail and design aesthetics - Ability to provide an editable format for future modifications
wf.summary: Client wants a professional, editable digital catalogue of mobile accessories with photos, names, and model compatibility, for retailers.

practice.q: What format must the catalogue be delivered in so the client can update it later?
options: A flat PDF image only
An editable design file like InDesign or Canva
A printed photo album
practice.why: The client needs future edits, so an editable file is essential. A flat PDF can be viewed but not easily updated. Always deliver the source file, not just the export.
practice.need: I'll build an editable catalogue with photos, names and model compatibility for your retailers.

wf.title: Modern Promotional Poster Design
wf.brief: I’m looking for a designer who can translate my business message into a clean, creative, and modern promotional poster. The poster’s sole purpose is to promote our product / service, so it has to capture attention quickly, communicate benefits at a glance, and remain consistent with our existing brand style. Here’s what I have in mind: • Visual approach: bold yet tidy layout, contemporary typography, and a colour palette that feels fresh without straying from our current branding. • Readability: information must be organised so a first-time viewer instantly grasps the key points and call-to-action. • Print-ready: final artwork should be supplied as a high-resolution PDF (CMYK, 300 dpi) along
wf.summary: Client wants a bold, clean, modern promo poster matching their brand, easy to read at a glance, delivered as a 300 dpi CMYK PDF.

practice.q: What does the client really need from this poster?
options: A quick, clear poster that sells the benefits and matches their brand
A full brand identity redesign with new colours and logo
A video ad with animated text for social media
practice.why: The brief asks for a poster that grabs attention fast, shows benefits at a glance, and stays on-brand. A redesign or video goes beyond it. Always check the print specs (CMYK, 300 dpi, PDF) before you start.
practice.need: I'll design a bold, clean poster in your brand colours, with benefits clear at a glance, as a 300 dpi CMYK PDF.

wf.title: Design Luxury Fashion Course Brochures
wf.brief: Hi, I am looking for a professional graphic designer to design 4 premium course brochures for BIFD (Bhuvan Institute of Fashion Design). Requirements: 1. 3 Aari Work Course Brochures (Basic, Advanced & Professional). 2. 1 Fashion Design Course Brochure. Design Expectations: - Premium, luxury and professional editorial-style design. - Elegant colour combinations with deep green, ivory/cream and champagne gold. - Professional typography with proper font pairing. - Clean layouts with sufficient whitespace. - High-quality fashion and embroidery photographs. - Consistent BIFD branding across all brochures. - Proper page alignment, hierarchy and readability. Deliverables: - Print-ready PDF (A4 siz
wf.summary: Design 4 luxury A4 brochures for BIFD: three Aari Work courses and one Fashion Design course, with matching branding.

practice.q: What does the client really need most from these four brochures?
options: One social media poster for the whole institute
Four matching, print-ready luxury brochures
A brand-new logo redesign from scratch
practice.why: Four separate brochures must look like one brand: same colours, fonts, grid, and print-ready A4 files. Consistent branding across all four is the core ask.
practice.need: I'll design four matching luxury A4 brochures for BIFD in deep green, ivory and gold.

wf.title: Instagram Branding Posts & Ads
wf.brief: I own Shivam Medical Food Supplements Store together with the PodiaFitnessLife gym in Panipat-Safidon-Jind, Haryana. To strengthen the brand and earn greater trust online, I need a fresh set of Instagram-ready visuals—both regular feed content and paid ad creatives—that highlight our premium supplements, modern gym facility and authentic customer results. I already handle day-to-day sales and training, so what I need from you is design expertise: eye-catching layouts, consistent colour palettes, clear typography and imagery that speaks to fitness lovers in North India. Content should feel informative rather than pushy, focusing on product quality, workout tips, client testimonials and behind
wf.summary: Design Instagram feed posts and paid ad visuals for a supplement store and gym in Haryana, India.

practice.q: What does the client actually want delivered for this job?
options: Video shoots and reels of the gym
Instagram feed and ad visuals with consistent branding
Full digital marketing strategy and ad campaign
practice.why: The brief asks for design work: layouts, colour palettes, typography and imagery for feed posts and ads. Filming, strategy and campaign management fall outside a beginner's scope. Focus on the visual design deliverables.
practice.need: I'll design on-brand Instagram feed posts and ad creatives for your supplements store and gym in Haryana.

wf.title: Cement Pipe Brochure Design
wf.brief: I need a detailed brochure to introduce our cement pipe products and our company. The main readers will be construction companies and contractors, government and infrastructure project buyers, and homeowners and small property developers. The brochure should include: - Pipe sizes, types, and technical specifications - Photos and examples of completed projects - Benefits, quality standards, and manufacturing process Ideal skills and experience: - Graphic design proficiency - Experience creating product brochures - Ability to present technical information clearly and attractively - Prior work with construction or manufacturing industries is a plus Looking forward to your creative proposals!
wf.summary: Design a detailed product brochure for cement pipes, covering specs, project photos, and manufacturing quality for contractors and buyers.

practice.q: Who is the main audience for this brochure, and what must it cover?
options: Homeowners only; focus on colours and style
Contractors, government buyers, and homeowners; cover specs, projects, and quality
Investors only; focus on company revenue
practice.why: The brief names three reader groups and wants technical specs, project examples, and quality standards. Design for all three, with clear technical info and attractive layout.
practice.need: I'll design a clear, attractive cement pipe brochure with specs, project photos, and quality standards for buyers.

cv.title: Modern Office CV & Letter
cv.brief: I need a polished set of application materials—CV, résumé, and cover letter—tailored specifically to office and administration roles. The final documents must look contemporary and professional while remaining clean and ATS-friendly. Please craft the layout in Microsoft Word, Canva, or any comparable platform, then supply both the editable files and ready-to-send PDFs. I value precise formatting, flawless grammar, and consistent styling throughout; no typos or spacing mishaps should slip through. Timely delivery is equally important to me. If you have several years of experience writing CVs for administrative careers, I want to hear from you. When you respond, focus on that experience; a con
cv.summary: Client wants a polished CV, résumé, and cover letter for office/admin roles, ATS-friendly, as editable files and PDFs.

practice.q: Which deliverables does the client actually need, and what must the documents be?
options: Just a cover letter in plain text
CV, résumé, and cover letter; editable and PDF; ATS-friendly
A LinkedIn profile and a portfolio website
practice.why: The brief asks for three documents, styled for office roles, delivered as editable files plus PDFs and kept ATS-friendly. Read every requirement before pitching.
practice.need: I'll build your CV, résumé, and cover letter for office and admin roles, ATS-friendly, in editable and PDF formats.

cv.title: ATS-Ready STEM Resume Revamp
cv.brief: I need a skilled resume writer to turn my existing CV into a clean, modern document that sails through Applicant Tracking Systems on Naukri and Indeed. My background: a STEM Master’s degree and more than three years of experience in data-focused environments. I am now targeting roles in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and, to a lesser extent, software development, cloud, or broader IT functions. Your task is to refashion the content with strong action verbs, tightly focused bullet points, and the right mix of keywords so recruiters can find me quickly. The design should be minimalist—no graphics that trip ATS—yet visu
cv.summary: Client wants an ATS-safe, minimalist CV rewrite for data and STEM roles on Naukri and Indeed.

practice.q: What should the revamped CV prioritize most for this client?
options: Fancy graphics and colourful layouts
Keywords and plain layout ATS can parse
A longer list of every past duty
practice.why: ATS parsers struggle with graphics, tables, and columns. A clean structure, strong verbs, and role keywords help recruiters find this candidate quickly.
practice.need: I'll rewrite your CV with an ATS-safe layout and data-role keywords for Naukri and Indeed.

cv.title: ATS-Friendly Resume Rewrite
cv.brief: I'm seeking a professional resume rewrite to help me apply for an Armed Federal Security Guard position. The goal is to make my resume cleaner and optimized to pass Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). Key Focus Areas: - Emphasize relevant skills and experience - Ensure formatting is ATS-friendly - Maintain clarity and professionalism Ideal skills and experience: - Proven expertise in resume writing - Familiarity with ATS requirements - Experience with security-related job applications
cv.summary: Client wants a clean, ATS-friendly resume rewrite for an Armed Federal Security Guard job, highlighting relevant skills.

practice.q: What does the client really need from this resume rewrite?
options: A creative, colorful design to stand out
A clean, ATS-readable resume highlighting security-relevant skills
A full cover letter and job search strategy
practice.why: Good read. ATS systems parse plain formatting best, so the job is clean layout, keyword alignment with the security role, and clear wording. Design flair and cover letters are outside the brief.
practice.need: I'll rewrite your resume into a clean, ATS-friendly format that highlights your security-relevant skills.

cv.title: Sales-Focused CV Creation
cv.brief: I want a brand-new CV built from my existing work history, positioned squarely for sales and customer service roles. The document should highlight achievements, metrics, and transferable soft skills in language that resonates with hiring managers and sails through ATS filters. A clean, modern layout that looks just as good in Word as it does in PDF is essential. I will supply my full employment chronology, education, and any figures you need. From there, I expect you to craft concise, persuasive wording, organise the sections logically, and weave in role-specific keywords without sounding forced. Please showcase your experience creating high-impact CVs—especially for sales or customer servic
cv.summary: Client wants a new sales/customer-service CV from their work history, ATS-friendly and modern in Word and PDF.

practice.q: What does the client most need from this CV?
options: A generic CV with no job focus
Achievements and keywords aimed at sales roles
A video résumé to send to recruiters
practice.why: Good read. The brief is about tailoring their real history into achievement-led, metric-driven wording for sales and customer service, while passing ATS filters and looking clean in both Word and PDF. Keep the focus on results, not just duties.
practice.need: I'll turn your work history into a sales-focused CV with metrics, ATS-friendly keywords, and a clean Word/PDF layout.

cv.title: Innovative Venture Builder CV Rewrite
cv.brief: I’m preparing to go into a startup-focused innovation role, specifically in venture building and new business and product development, and I need my existing CV transformed so it speaks the language that founders, VCs, and corporate venture arms expect. You’ll take my current résumé, dig into the achievements that prove I can spot opportunities, validate markets, and launch products, then recast them with clear impact metrics and keywords recruiters’ ATS systems flag—terms like “lean experimentation,” “MVP,” “go-to-market,” and “fund-raising.” The tone has to balance entrepreneurial energy with strategic rigour, showing I can move from vision to viable business while steering cross-functiona
cv.summary: Client wants their CV rewritten for venture building and innovation roles, with impact metrics and ATS keywords.

practice.q: What is the main thing the client wants from this CV rewrite?
options: A generic CV with more design
Achievements reframed for startup and VC hiring
A cover letter for a sales job
practice.why: A strong venture-builder CV turns past wins into proof of opportunity spotting, market validation and launches, using measurable results and ATS-friendly terms.
practice.need: I'll recast your achievements with impact metrics and ATS keywords for venture building roles.

ig.title: Social Media Ad Design Specialist
ig.brief: I need a creative designer to create engaging social media posts and ads for Instagram and Facebook. The main goal of these designs is to promote our Sports and fitness brand Key Requirements: - Create visually appealing and engaging designs. - Platform-specific designs for Instagram and Facebook. - Focus on product/service promotion. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in social media design. - Strong portfolio showcasing relevant work. - Proficiency in design software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite). - Ability to understand and incorporate brand guidelines. - Knowledge of current design trends and social media algorithms. Please provide a portfolio with your bids.
ig.summary: Client wants eye-catching Instagram and Facebook posts and ads that promote their sports and fitness brand, tailored to each platform.

practice.q: Which deliverable best matches what the client really needs?
options: Write a full marketing strategy and posting calendar
Design platform-specific posts and ads that promote the brand
Film workout videos and edit them into reels
practice.why: The client wants visual designs, sized and styled for each platform, that sell the brand. Strategy, filming, and recruiting are outside this brief. Focus on what the posts look like and how they follow the brand guidelines.
practice.need: I'll design Instagram and Facebook posts and ads that promote your sports brand and follow your guidelines.

ig.title: Social Media Post and Graphic Creation
ig.brief: I’m looking for a creative partner who can take full ownership of designing eye-catching social media content for my brand. The core of the job is simple: plan and produce original posts—both the copy and the accompanying graphics—that feel on-brand and encourage engagement. Here’s what I need from you each week: • 3–5 static or carousel images sized for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn • Short, punchy captions (with relevant hashtags) that align with the visuals • Editable source files (Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator) along with export-ready PNG/JPG versions I’ll supply brand guidelines, recent campaign examples, and any photography assets I already have. From there, you’ll brainstorm, d
ig.summary: Weekly on-brand posts for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, with copy, graphics and editable source files.

practice.q: What does the client really need from you each week?
options: One nicely designed post
3-5 original posts, copy and editable files
Only captions, with the client doing graphics
practice.why: Look past the pretty graphic. The real deliverables are 3-5 posts a week, sized for three platforms, with captions and editable files. Plan the whole package.
practice.need: I'll design your weekly on-brand posts, captions and editable files for all three platforms.

ig.title: Minimalist Canva To-Do List Design
ig.brief: I need a clean, minimalist two-page to-do list created in Canva, sized for US Letter. Both pages must be fully editable so I can tweak colours, text and layout later. Page one carries the main heading “TO DO LIST”, then splits into two even columns: “PERSONAL” on the left, “WORK” on the right. Under each column the weekdays Monday through Friday appear as simple text labels only—no boxes or separator lines—leaving open space beneath every day for handwriting. Page two repeats the “TO DO LIST” heading and uses the same two-column structure for “PERSONAL” and “WORK”, but this time only Saturday and Sunday sit under each column. Directly below, the page divides horizontally into three clear sec
ig.summary: Editable US Letter Canva to-do list: weekdays on page one, weekend and three sections on page two.

practice.q: What must page two include that page one doesn't?
options: Weekend columns plus three sections below
Full Monday to Sunday repeated on each page
Weekdays with boxes and separator lines
practice.why: Page two drops the weekdays and shows only Saturday and Sunday under each column, then splits into three sections. Keep labels plain and leave space for handwriting.
practice.need: I'll design your editable US Letter Canva to-do list, with weekday and weekend pages.

ig.title: Canva Social Media Graphics
ig.brief: I need a versatile Canva designer who can turn my ideas into eye-catching Instagram posts and stories, Facebook posts and ad creatives, plus LinkedIn posts and header banners. Every graphic should push one clear purpose—promoting our products and services—while staying consistent with our brand colours, fonts, and voice. Here’s how I picture the workflow: I’ll share a short brief for each campaign (headline, key message, and any reference images). You’ll translate that into on-brand visuals that feel native to each platform’s dimensions and best practices. All source files must remain editable in Canva so we can tweak copy or swap images later if needed. Deliverables for each campaign: • Ins
ig.summary: Client wants on-brand Canva graphics for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, all editable, each promoting products or services.

practice.q: What must every graphic do, and what must stay consistent across all of them?
options: Be funny and go viral on each platform
Push one clear purpose, match brand colours, fonts and voice
Use the newest trending templates for each campaign
practice.why: Each graphic needs one clear purpose: promoting products or services. Brand colours, fonts and voice stay consistent, and files must stay editable in Canva so copy and images can be swapped later.
practice.need: I'll turn your campaign briefs into on-brand, editable Canva posts sized right for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

ig.title: Social Ads Designer for Client Packs
ig.brief: Facebook and Instagram Ad Designer, Per-Project Work, English and Spanish. Rodgate Digital designs and runs ads for US small businesses. We need designers we can send ad packs to as clients order them. Typical order: 3 to 10 static ads in feed (1:1 or 4:5) and story (9:16) sizes, from a brief and brand kit we provide. Paid per pack through Freelancer.com. Our budget is about $100 for one 5-ad pack in 2 sizes. Work starts when a client orders. You have: - A portfolio of real social ads, not just posts - Editable source files (PSD, AI, Figma or Canva) with every order - A 48 to 72 hour turnaround on a 5-ad pack - Spanish is a plus In your bid, include: 1) Links to your 5 best ad designs. 2) Yo
ig.summary: Client wants 3-10 static Facebook/Instagram ads per pack (1:1 or 4:5 feed, 9:16 story) built from their brief and brand kit, in editable source files.

practice.q: What does the client actually need delivered for each order?
options: One long video ad with filming
A full ad strategy and audience research plan
3-10 static ads in feed and story sizes with editable files
practice.why: Read the brief closely: they want static ad designs in specific sizes, delivered as editable source files, not video, strategy, or research. Start with the sizes and file types.
practice.need: I'll design your 5-ad pack in 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 from your brief and brand kit, with editable source files.
